templates.title: Ferret
templates.name: ferret
templates.description: Self-hosted home inventory: find anything you own. Photos, barcodes, QR labels, warranties, maintenance and an insurance report, with a REST API, an MCP server and optional AI on your own models.
templates.note: Open it and sign up: the first account runs the server. Ferret makes its own secrets on first start; once it runs, make a key file (Settings → Server → Keys) and keep it somewhere else.

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Address you open Ferret at
env.description: For example http://192.168.1.10:8787 — links Ferret sends, passkeys and single sign-on use it.
